provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Bravelyn is centered at -65.170379, -34.488476 under Gerontocracy, with 35,977,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Bravelyn occupies 4,225,400.18 sq mi / 10,943,736.23 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.145553% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and reefs with water, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming and Mountain range. Population density is 3.287 people/sq km / 8.514 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Triton, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Glasswell Institute, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Sigrananna, Setrimir, Raeshkul, Iskareth, Bastveig, and 3 more.

npcs.name: Chirra Clickspring
npcs.description:
Chirra Clickspring is a sharp-eyed, fast-talking caravan merchant whose cheer comes in sparks: bright, jittery, funny, and always a little too close to panic. As a Gandirosha, fae has a natural feel for luck, hidden danger, loaded bargains, false smiles, and the tiny social openings that let a merchant survive roads full of monsters, debt collectors, and armed customers.
Fae sells blades, black-powder weapons, thundercoil parts, ammunition, ward charms, and “totally legal” diluted ichor tonics along the Caravan Bell Route, but faer dependency on purer black-market ichor makes faer hands shake and faer judgment unreliable. Publicly, Chirra is a The Brass Concordat trader out of Qasvire in Bravelyn; secretly, fae sells route gossip, fugitive sightings, and suspicious traveler names to whoever pays enough, then laughs too loudly when accused of having a conscience.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Qasvire is a City in Bravelyn, under Gerontocracy, with severe danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Gandirosha reads through the Fey-Folk entry of the race compendium, within Fey and Trickster Folk, marked by Thalunesh. Fey-Folk are peoples shaped by glamour, luck, tiny or otherworldly bodies, dreamlike emotion, and trickster magic. At my table, Faerie, Fairy, and Gandirosha are not separate top-level races here; they are bloodlines. Table cues: Fey Creature Type or Fey Ancestry, Fey Magic, Glamour or Luck Expression, Small/Tiny Fey Presence; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Cooperative - Neutral.

npcs.name: The Wanderer
npcs.description:
The Wanderer is a tired, practical Orc armor archivist who once served a proud militant order before leaving when its ideals curdled into hoarding, hierarchy, and self-importance. As an Enkirael-shaped Orc, they understand survival, discipline, martial power, and hard choices, but they now measure strength by whether armor protects people rather than whether it makes rulers look untouchable.
At the Qasvire Watch Office, they work with the Crucible Wardens cataloging battlefield gear, repairing protective plates, selling reinforced armor, and identifying relic pieces contaminated by ichor exposure or old divine residue. They are blunt, road-worn, quietly principled, and ready to settle somewhere useful, though they still carry the guarded sadness of someone who remembers when their old oath meant something.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Qasvire is a City in Bravelyn, under Gerontocracy, with severe danger, Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Orc reads through the Human entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Orc (Human + Orc Lineage). Humans are highly adaptable and found in nearly every environment across the world. They are known for their cultural diversity, short generational cycles, and unmatched versatility among mortal races.
